title: Steam (client only)
notes: Installs only the Windows Steam client, without a game. Steam's UI freezes under msync/esync, so sync is off.
Steam's first start downloads and unpacks the client (~235 MB); it can take a few minutes depending on your connection and may look frozen (measured on M1: update ~1 min, UI ~40 s).

knownIssues.symptom: The Steam window stays black on the Wine 11 engine
knownIssues.cause: GPU acceleration in web views is off in Steam's settings
knownIssues.fix: Settings → Interface → keep 'GPU accelerated rendering in web views' on

knownIssues.symptom: Steam closes before sign-in after its first update
knownIssues.cause: A Steam client issue (also seen on Linux)
knownIssues.fix: Open it again; it does not repeat after the first sign-in
